item.title: NASA delays historic Artemis II moon mission after fuel leak discovery
item.description: NASA has delayed the historic Artemis II crewed mission to March after engineers discovered a liquid hydrogen leak during a critical wet dress rehearsal. The test also revealed additional issues, including a valve on the Orion crew module that needed retorquing, cold weather affecting cameras, and intermittent audio dropouts among ground teams.

item.title: H-E-B Riverside closes temporarily after 'small fire' in toilet paper aisle
item.description: An H-E-B in southeast Austin had to close for the day on Wednesday, but plans to open its doors back up on Thursday.

item.title: City of Austin audit vote postponed, workers union weighs in
item.description: A letter sent to Austin city council members and the mayor from AFSCME Local 1624 -- the city's labor union -- raises concerns about an item that was supposed to be on Thursday's Austin City Council agenda but has been postponed.

item.title: City removes park surveillance item from Thursday council agenda after public pushback
item.description: Austin City Council members were set to vote on a contract between the Austin Parks and Recreation Department and a surveillance technology company during their regular meeting this week, but the item got pulled from the agenda at the last minute.

item.title: Texas DPS hit with $1.6M jury verdict in race discrimination, retaliation lawsuit
item.description: A federal jury has awarded more than $1.6 million in combined damages after finding that the Texas Department of Public Safety subjected two employees to race-based harassment and retaliated against one of them for complaining about discrimination.

item.title: A suggestion box to 'nowhere': Kerrville city staff admit online portal inactive during aftermath of July 4th Floods
item.description: A suggestion box to "nowhere." It's what Kerrville residents call an online portal after City of Kerrville staff admit the inactive website was linked to their frontpage for more than two years, unable to read anonymous complaints from concerned citizens.

item.title: Texas football makes big decision regarding spring football
item.description: Texas football made the decision in 2025 not to have a spring game. That won't be the case in 2026.

item.title: Therapist arrested, charged with sexually assaulting juvenile patient, police say
item.description: Erin Roush, 29, of Georgetown, is accused of assaulting a juvenile patient, according to police.

item.title: Central Texas students continue walkouts to protest ICE
item.description: A day after the Texas Education Agency released guidance and consequences over ICE related student walkouts as well as educator and district responsibilities, there were more reports of school walkouts across Central Texas.

item.title: 'Outrageous': Texas seizes victim funds for old debts, KXAN investigation finds
item.description: After years of investigating problems with Texas' Crime Victims' Compensation Fund, a viewer tip revealed a new and unexpected issue: The state is seizing millions of dollars earmarked for victims of violent crimes to collect on old, unrelated debts.
